items.title: The island sits level
steps: Look at the island on Home and then over an app, on the cover screen and on the unfolded screen.
It should sit at the same height in both places and on both screens.
On the unfolded screen, turn Hide in Landscape on: the island should stay unless you also turn on Also on the Unfolded Screen.

items.title: Island card and calls
steps: Open the island card on Home, then tap anywhere outside it: it should close and not open what is underneath.
Have someone call you (or use a timer): swipe a ringing call's card up. It should shrink to the pill and keep ringing; tap the pill to bring the card back.
Turn Reduce Motion on: the pill and card should fade, and the music bars should stand still.

items.title: Home button on Home
steps: On the second Home page, press the Home button: Home should go to the first page.
Open an app from page 2, then press Home: you should return to page 2.
With a sheet, menu or Edit mode open, Home only closes it.

items.title: A cancelled drag puts the app back
steps: Start dragging an app, then let Android cancel it (for example pull down the shade mid-drag).
The app should be back where it was.

items.title: Spotlight opens apps and keeps them open
steps: If you use Discover as the left page, open apps from Spotlight and from App Library search.
They should open and stay in front.

items.title: App Library search
steps: Type in the search: results should start at the top, with the web search row visible.
Open an app from a result and come back: the search should be empty.
Opening the library should not flash the whole A to Z list before the category tiles.

items.title: Clear Suggestions History
steps: Tap Clear Suggestions History and confirm.
Spotlight, the App Library Suggestions tile and the Suggestions widget should start empty and learn again as you open apps.

items.title: Home never stays blurred
steps: Open and close sheets, menus, folders and pages, and switch between apps.
Home should never stay blurred with nothing in front.

items.title: Safe Mode stays on until you leave it
steps: Turn Safe Mode on and wait a minute: it should still be on.
If a newer Home layout came from a newer Folio, the notice should say so.

items.title: Settings opens on your layout
steps: Hold the phone upright on the unfolded screen and open Settings: it should open on the layout you are using.
The sliders should change what you see.

items.title: Restoring a Layout Backup
steps: Restore a backup that has Smart Stacks: each stack should keep its own widgets.
Export a backup: it should list only apps the layout uses.
A damaged-layout notice: Restore should restore.

items.title: Focus and Smart Rotate
steps: Turn a Focus off by hand and restart Folio: it should stay off.
Smart Rotate should count time away from Home toward its wait.

items.title: Small fixes
steps: An Icon Action that opens an app you removed should say it is unavailable.
Tap an unavailable app in a folder: you should get the same notice as on Home.
Start reordering a folder and cancel: the saved order should come back.

items.title: The new setup (optional)
steps: Open the new setup from here. Nothing changes unless you choose something.
Look at the starting-point choices, and leave without changing anything if you like.
